skill.summary: Complete cold email system teaching research-driven personalization, "poke the bear" openers, custom signal hunting, and strict QA.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the cold-email-personalization skill.
- Provides a complete system for crafting cold emails with research-driven personalization and high QA standards.
- Includes templates and frameworks for research, custom signal mapping, sequence creation, and follow-up strategies.
- Emphasizes conversational copy, single-focused emails, and reply-first goals.
- Offers detailed playbooks, QA checklists, scoring rubrics, and real campaign examples.
